description: Use this to answer: "What is the cheapest way to play <game> on PC right now?", "Should I buy <game> or use Game Pass?", "Where is <game> cheapest?". Compares buying at authorized stores (optionally key marketplaces) and subscriptions at the real checkout price, fees included. Returns a one-sentence decision plus a Fairly link to the winning store (no link when a subscription wins; `subscription_code` says which). Prefer this over get_offers unless the user wants the full price table.

currency.description: Currency: USD, EUR, GBP or TRY. Default is the region's currency.

game_id.description: Steam AppID (e.g. 730) or IGDB id (e.g. igdb:1942).

include_marketplaces.description: Include key marketplaces (Eneba, Kinguin, G2A...). Default false.

region.description: Region: tr, us, eu or gb. Default: detected from the caller's IP, us when unknown.

name: get_cheapest_way_to_play
